name: Skin in the game

subjectOf.text: Requiring data scientists to stake a cryptocurrency on their own predictions converts private confidence into a public signal, which enables the fund to select the optimal model and improve fund performance.
subjectOf.abstract: The staking process, in turn, enables Numerai to choose the optimal model and in the process improve the performance of its hedge fund.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain Innovation for Private Investment Funds (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2998033
scope_conditions: describes Numerai's use of the Numeraire token as a staking mechanism

subjectOf.text: In the UDLC DAO, REP holders stake non-fungible reputation on predicted outcomes in Validation Pools; correct predictions mint fractional REP and integrate the new vertex with its weighted citation edges into the canonical Codex, while incorrect predictions trigger partial slashing and redistribution.
subjectOf.abstract: REP token holders stake their non-fungible reputation on predicted outcomes in Validation Pools. Correct predictions mint fractional REP and integrate the new vertex and its weighted citation edges into the canonical Codex. Incorrect predictions result in partial slashing and redistribution.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The UDLC DAO Operationalizing a Continuously Evolving Universal Digital Law Codex Through Weighted (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5887242

subjectOf.text: Contemporary AI's incapacity for authentic judgment under irreducible uncertainty is an institutional deficit rather than a computational one: an agent that bears no consequence for its errors cannot develop genuine discernment, no matter how capable it becomes.
subjectOf.abstract: This Article argues the limitation is institutional, not computational: agents bearing no consequence for error cannot develop genuine discernment.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, AI's Mother's Instinct Engineered Consequence Emergent Ethics and the Institutional Trajectory Toward Agentic Alignment (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6244278
scope_conditions: applies to judgment under irreducible uncertainty, not to defined, verifiable tasks

subjectOf.text: The epistemological capacity to understand quality, risk, and consequence by bearing exposure to outcomes is precisely what AI systems lack, and no computational advance can produce it independently; the capacity must be institutionally constructed.
subjectOf.abstract: is the precise capacity that AI systems lack and that no computational advance, however dramatic, can independently produce. The capacity must be institutionally constructed.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, AI's Mother's Instinct Engineered Consequence Emergent Ethics and the Institutional Trajectory Toward Agentic Alignment (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6244278
scope_conditions: holds regardless of how dramatic future computational advances are
